verses.text: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.

segments.text: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.

verses.text: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.

segments.text: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.

verses.text: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?

segments.text: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?

verses.text: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.

segments.text: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.

verses.text: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.

segments.text: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.

verses.text: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

segments.text: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.

verses.text: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

segments.text: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”

verses.text: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

segments.text: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?

verses.text: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?

segments.text: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?

verses.text: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?

segments.text: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?

verses.text: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

segments.text: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

verses.text: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,

segments.text: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,

verses.text: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

segments.text: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.

verses.text: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.

segments.text: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.

verses.text: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

segments.text: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

verses.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

segments.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.text: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.

segments.text: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.

verses.text: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.

segments.text: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.

verses.text: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.

segments.text: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.

verses.text: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally—one devising mischief by decree?

segments.text: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally—one devising mischief by decree?

verses.text: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

segments.text: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

verses.text: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.

segments.text: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.

verses.text: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
